rules.text: BREAKING when, inside 6h, two independent outlets carry one event within 20 minutes of each other, or one tier-one outlet (a lab's own channel, or a wire / paper-of-record / major tech desk) plus one more independent outlet. speed.definition: Median time from the timestamp an outlet put on an item to the moment SIREN first saw it, per source, over the last 24 hours. It includes the outlet's own feed delay and SIREN's polling interval. It is not a comparison with any other service. Items more than 24 hours old when first seen, and everything from a source's first fetch, are left out. GDELT items are timed from GDELT's own crawl, not the outlet's; X items from the post id.
